sections.title: Turn written words into natural spoken audio
sections.subtitle: Choose from a range of voices, clone your own, and generate full multi-speaker conversations on demand. No recording equipment, no voice actors, no waiting.

sections.title: Why RuneWorks Text-to-Speech
sections.subtitle: High-quality voice generation that is affordable, reliable and straightforward to use.

items.title: Natural-sounding speech
items.text: Clear, pleasant audio for narration, lessons, announcements and more, with adjustable speed, pitch and volume.

items.title: Voice cloning
items.text: Create a reusable voice from a recording you have permission to use, then apply it consistently across all your content.

items.title: Multi-speaker conversations
items.text: Assign a voice to each participant, control pauses and overlaps, and export one recording or each line separately.

items.title: Affordable plans
items.text: Subscription allowances that suit small developers and businesses, with usage you can review at any time.

items.title: Projects and spaces
items.text: Organise scripts, speakers and recordings into projects, and share them with your team through spaces.

items.title: Private and secure
items.text: Your recordings, voices and generated audio stay private to your space, with retention periods you control.

items.title: Pick or create a voice
items.text: Use a preset voice or upload a recording to clone your own.

items.title: Write your script
items.text: Enter a single passage or a conversation between several speakers.

items.title: Generate and download
items.text: Receive audio as MP3, WAV or OGG, ready for your website, app or podcast.

sections.title: Ready to hear your content?
sections.subtitle: Create a free account and generate your first recording in minutes.
